raw_segments.text: At last some four or five of us were summoned to our meal in an adjoining room.
No fire at all, the landlord said he couldn't afford it.
Nothing but two dismal tallow candles, each in a winding sheet.
We were fain to button up our monkey jackets and hold to our lips cups of scalding tea
But the fair was of the most substantial kind, not only meat and potatoes but dumplings,
One young fellow in a green box coat addressed himself to these dumplings in a most direful manner.
